-- 2. DYNAMIC CRYSTAL OPENER LOOP
local function runEggLoop()
    while _G.AutoBuyEggs do
        local remote = getCrystalRemote()
        if remote then
            remote:FireServer("openCrystal", _G.SelectedCrystal)
        end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
end

-- 3. GLITCH PET LOOP
local function runGlitchLoop()
    local targetRock = workspace:FindFirstChild("Muscle King Mountain Rock") or workspace:FindFirstChild("Rock")
    local punchRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("punchRemoteName") or replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("punchRemote")
    while _G.AutoGlitch do
        if targetRock and localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetRock.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 5)
        end
        if punchRemote then punchRemote:FireServer("punchAction", "Rock") end
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end

-- 4. AUTO-REBIRTH LOOP
local function runRebirthLoop()
    local rebirthRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("rebirthRemote") or replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Rebirth")
    while _G.AutoRebirth do
        if rebirthRemote then rebirthRemote:FireServer("rebirthRequest") end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

-- 5. WATER PHYSICS MECHANIC
local function updateWaterPhysics()
    while _G.WalkOnWater do
        if localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            localPlayer.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false)
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
    if localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        localPlayer.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, true)
    end
end

-- 6. AUTO-EQUIP BEST PETS LOOP
local function runEquipBestLoop()
    local equipRemote = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("equipPetRemote") or replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("equipBestPets") or replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PetRemote")
    while _G.AutoEquipBest do
        if equipRemote then
            -- Muscle Legends typically takes "equipBestPets" or "equipBest" as the main function string argument
            equipRemote:FireServer("equipBestPets") 
        end
        task.wait(5) -- 5-second interval to avoid interface flickering or server lag
    end
end

-- 7. AUTO-COLLECT CHESTS LOOP
local function runChestLoop()
    -- Map coordinates for standard reward chest proximity boundaries in Muscle Legends
    local chestLocations = {
        Vector3.new(2, 4, 15),     -- Group Chest / Spawn Chest
        Vector3.new(-220, 4, 30),  -- Golden Chest
        Vector3.new(50, 15, -400)  -- Magma / Legends Chest area
    }
    
    while _G.AutoCollectChests do
        if localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local originalPos = localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            
            -- Cycle through each known map chest location
            for _, position in ipairs(chestLocations) do
                if not _G.AutoCollectChests then break end
                
                -- Swiftly teleport to the chest, wait briefly for the server to acknowledge touch, then move to next
                localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
            
            -- Return back to your starting location so your farming loops aren't broken completely
            localPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = originalPos
        end
        task.wait(30) -- Chests have timers; checks every 30 seconds to keep your farm optimized
    end
end

-- 9. AUTO-DELETE FILTER LOOP
local function runDeleteLoop()
    local petRemote = getPetRemote()
    while _G.DeleteRarity ~= "None" do
        -- Accesses the player's local data folder containing unequipped inventory objects
        local petFolder = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("Pets") or localPlayer:FindFirstChild("PetFolder")
        if petFolder and petRemote then
            for _, pet in ipairs(petFolder:GetChildren()) do
                -- Checks if the pet's rarity tag matches your dropdown preference
                local rarity = pet:FindFirstChild("Rarity") or pet:FindFirstChild("Tier")
                if rarity and rarity.Value == _G.DeleteRarity then
                    -- Fires server call to permanently scrap the targeted item
                    petRemote:FireServer("deletePet", pet.Name)
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(1.5)
    end
end
